projects.title: Path Search on Urban Bus Networks
bullets: Constructed graphs from public urban bus route tables using Python and NetworkX as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone project.
Implemented shortest-path queries and tested disconnected graph cases for path search on public urban bus networks.

research.title: Path Search on Multimodal Transit Networks
bullets: Constructed graphs from public multimodal transit route tables using Python and NetworkX as part of supervised faculty research.
Implemented shortest-path queries and compared search times on sampled graphs representing public multimodal transit networks.

research.title: Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Parsed small public string-processing example programs with Python as part of supervised research on static checks for programming exercises.
Implemented syntax-tree traversal using abstract syntax trees for static checks on the small example programs.
